description: Semi-empirical SOC-only voltage model for Na-ion battery (prismatic cell)
source: Tremblay & Dessaint (2009) framework adapted for Na-ion; CATL first-gen Na-ion press release data

cell.name: CATL-inspired Na-ion Prismatic Cell
cell.chemistry: Na-ion (layered oxide cathode / hard carbon anode)

internal_resistance.note: Higher than Li-ion due to Na+ larger ionic radius

ocv_coefficients.note: OCV(SOC) = a0 + a1*SOC + a2*SOC^2 + a3*SOC^3 + a4*SOC^4 + a5*SOC^5
